::: {#thm-irls-newton}

#### An IRLS step is a Newton-Raphson step and a Fisher scoring step

Suppose the outcomes follow the [logistic regression model](#def-logistic-regression).
One step of [iteratively reweighted least squares](#def-irls) from $\vcoef^*$ equals

- one step of the [Newton-Raphson algorithm](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-newton-raphson) on the [log-likelihood](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-loglik) from $\vcoef^*$, and
- one step of [Fisher scoring](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-fisher-scoring) from $\vcoef^*$:

$$
\vcoef^* + \inv{\paren{\tp{X} W X}} \tp{X} \paren{\voutvar - \vprob^*}.
$$ {#eq-irls-newton}

:::

::: proof

The [log-likelihood](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-loglik) has [score](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-score) $\tp{X} \paren{\voutvar - \vprob}$ and [Hessian](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-hessian) $-\tp{X} W X$ at every $\vcoef$ (with $\vprob$ and $W$ computed from $\vcoef$),
and the Hessian does not involve the outcomes
(proof of @thm-logistic-mle-distribution).
So the [observed information](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-oinf) $\tp{X} W X$ equals the [expected information](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-einf),
and the Newton-Raphson and [Fisher scoring](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-fisher-scoring) steps both equal @eq-irls-newton.

For [IRLS](#def-irls), the working responses satisfy $W \vecf{z} = W X \vcoef^* + \paren{\voutvar - \vprob^*}$, so

$$
\ba
\inv{\paren{\tp{X} W X}} \tp{X} W \vecf{z}
&= \inv{\paren{\tp{X} W X}} \tp{X} W X \vcoef^* + \inv{\paren{\tp{X} W X}} \tp{X} \paren{\voutvar - \vprob^*}
&& \text{(substitute } W \vecf{z} \text{)}
\\
&= \vcoef^* + \inv{\paren{\tp{X} W X}} \tp{X} \paren{\voutvar - \vprob^*}.
&& \text{(cancel } \tp{X} W X \text{)}
\ea
$$

:::
